title: Biostatistician
summary: Plans the statistics of clinical trials (how many patients, which tests) and analyses the results that show whether a medicine works and is safe. Sits in the biostatistics team of a drug company or contract research organisation, leading statistical programmers and working with doctors, data managers and medical writers.
dailyDuties: Calculate sample size and power for new trial protocols
Write statistical analysis plans and table shells
Run survival and mixed-model analyses in SAS or R
Review ADaM specifications and derived datasets
Check tables, listings and figures from programmers
Write statistical sections of study reports
Answer statistical questions from sponsors and regulators

skills.expectation: Write and follow statistical analysis plans within ICH GCP and trial protocols
Calculate sample size and power and set up randomisation for trial protocols
Choose and apply the right inferential methods for efficacy and safety endpoints
Analyse time-to-event endpoints with Kaplan-Meier, log-rank tests and Cox models
Fit ANCOVA, logistic and mixed models such as MMRM for trial endpoints
Run analyses in SAS or R and check programmers' outputs
Run analyses in SAS or R and check programmers' outputs
Review ADaM specifications and derived analysis datasets
Explain results to clinical teams and sponsors and write statistical sections of reports
Review and QC tables, listings and figures against the plan
Understand SDTM data that feeds analysis datasets
Use Python for simulations or exploratory analysis
Coordinate with programming, data management and medical writing teams
